description.value:
Grown from Seed-Warden stock; toes that open like roots. 1 action to root into bare earth, stone, or living ground: while rooted you have a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against forced movement and to your DCs against being moved, and you draw water and trace nutrition from the ground (no food/water clock while rooted somewhere living). 1 action to pull free.

Rider: Ground you root in for more than an hour has a claim on you. Leaving it behind for good costs a Will save (moderate DC) or you are compelled to return within a day.

cinderfall.incomplete: The 'no food/water clock while rooted somewhere living' and the Will-save compulsion to return to long-rooted ground both have no engine hook -- confirmed absence, same as the mutations pass's Deep-Root-Legs (no hunger-clock mechanism exists anywhere in pf2e) and no rule element represents a narrative geas like this. The bonus to your own DCs against being moved (as opposed to your save) also has no selector, for the same reason flagged on Ballast-Gut-Plate.
